verdict.rationale: Signifyd is a fraud-protection platform with a merchant console, so a built-in AI assistant is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack covers only REST APIs, webhooks, SDKs, device profiling and Decision Center policy configuration. It has nothing on a console-native AI assistant for natural-language queries over fraud data, drafted rules or investigation summaries. Decision Center policies are an adjacent rules feature, not an AI assistant.

support.subject: As a risk analyst, the product ships its own AI assistant — natural-language queries over my fraud data, drafted rules, investigation summaries — built into the console
